name: Clockwork Buccaneer
body:
Clockwork Buccaneer
CR 9

This mechanical humanoid bears the trappings and arms of a pirate lord and even sports a mask-like face of flesh and blood overlaying its inward mechanisms.

XP 6,400
N Medium construct (clockwork)
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft, low-light vision; Perception +2

DEFENSE

AC 28, touch 16, flat-footed 22 (+6 Dex, +12 natural)
hp 86 (12d10+20)
Fort +4 Ref +10 Will +6
DR 10/adamantine; Immune construct traits
Weaknesses vulnerability to electricity

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee scimitar +18/+13/+8 (1d6+7/18-20)
Ranged arm gun +16 (1d8, scatter)
Special Attacks pirate’s feint, water jet (DC 18)

STATISTICS

Str 21, Dex 22, Con -, Int -, Wis 14, Cha 1
Base Atk +12; CMB +17; CMD 33
Feats Ability Focus (water jet)B, Improved FeintB, Improved Vital StrikeB,Vital StrikeB
Skills Bluff -5 (+10 to feint); Racial Modifiers +8 Bluff to feint only
Languages Common (can’t speak)
SQ water tank

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Arm Gun (Ex)

The clockwork buccaneer’s arm gun has the statistics of a blunderbuss and uses firearm rules, but counts as a natural weapon. When the clockwork buccaneer makes a full attack, it can make one attack with the arm gun as a secondary weapon at -5 to hit. Using its internal mechanisms, the clockwork buccaneer can reload as a move action.

Damage 1d8, Range 15-foot cone scatter (scatter penalty included in the statistics above).

Pirate’s Feint (Ex)

The clockwork buccaneer uses its Wisdom in place of Charisma on Bluff checks to feint.

Water Jet (Ex)

When its water talk is full, the clockwork buccaneer can aim a narrow but highly pressurized blast of water in a 60-foot line, dealing 10d6 bludgeoning damage to creatures and unattended objects in the area. A creature or object can make a DC 18 Fortitude saving throw to take half damage. Creatures and objects that fail the save are also knocked back 5 feet. This empties the clockwork buccaneer’s water tank.

Water Jump (Ex)

When its water tank is full, the clockwork buccaneer can propel itself through the air with a jet of water, allowing it to jump 60 feet as a move action. This empties the clockwork buccaneer’s water tank.

Water Tank (Ex)

As a full-round action, the clockwork buccaneer can extend a clockwork tube up 15 feet into a body of water and refill its water tank.

ECOLOGY

Environment any water, or any coastal terrain
Organization solitary, gang (2-8), or boarding party (3-12)
Treasure standard (+1 scimitar, 30 handfuls of pellets and powder, and other treasure)

Clockwork buccaneers are powerful constructs designed for naval combat. Whereas most clockwork creations sink to the ocean floor while at sea, clockwork buccaneers can use their water jets to easily propel themselves through the water or leap aboard enemy ships. In addition to an internal water tank and hydraulic pumps, most clockwork buccaneers are equipped with a cutlass and arm gun loaded with scatter shot. Some inventors choose to imbue their clockwork buccaneers with automated voice modules instead of water tanks. Buccaneers can use these prerecorded songs, shanties, or phrases to inspire living crew members or strike fear into enemies.
